WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
    FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN net_lines n ON n.business_date = d.calendar_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8
    GROUP BY ALL
),
ctl AS (SELECT business_date, SUM(net_sales) AS ctl, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_sales END) AS web FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.fiscal_year, m.fiscal_week, m.calendar_date, m.day_name, m.is_trading_day, m.holiday_name, m.mine, c.ctl, c.web, m.mine - c.ctl AS diff
FROM mine m LEFT JOIN ctl c ON c.business_date = m.calendar_date
ORDER BY m.fiscal_year DESC, m.calendar_date

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-20' AND DATE '2026-07-05' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-20' AND DATE '2026-07-05'
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT MIN(f.sale_date) AS first_date, MAX(f.sale_date) AS last_date, COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS days, COUNT(DISTINCT f.store_key) AS stores,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_ly_p2,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_ty_p2
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
